lina_cs: Quick heads-up 9 ZenPath onboarding asks for Osaka + Tokyo edge allowlists and a short transient rate uplift for a partner pilot Tues 2026-06-10 10:00 JST. Expect ~2.5k calls over ~40m. Also flag: renewal in 3.5 weeks, low prod usage last 50d.
rachel_se: They want to demo to two regional partners simultaneously (osaka + tokyo). Both originate from our managed VPC but can provide egress CIDRs.
ashley_net: OK. CIDRs or header allowlist? And do they need different rules per edge?
lina_cs: ask for both so ops can choose: CIDR for osaka and header for tokyo as fallback. Capture start/end & QPS.
miguel_ops: Need exact CIDRs, start/end, burst vs sustained, p95 target, and whether to enable KV prefix caching for the staging key. Also prefer auto-expire + ticketed flow.
takashi_zenpath: (customer) sending CIDRs now: osaka 198.51.100.64/27, tokyo 198.51.100.96/27. Start 2026-06-10T10:00:00+09:00, duration 45m. Burst 130 req/s each region, sustained 55 req/s. p95 target <180ms. We'll include a header fallback X-RW-DEMO: zenpath and x-rw-customer: zenpath-pilot.
ashley_net: thanks. i'll prepare allowlist rules: osaka-edge scoped CIDR + tokyo-edge header rule, both auto-expire at 2026-06-10T11:00:00+09:00, auto-revoke turned on.
miguel_ops: will configure fallback routing to model-compact when p95 > 300ms for >60s, enable prefix KV caching for prefix zenpath/pilot, and instrument an eval endpoint with tags. Also add traffic shaping so sustained qps doesn't exceed quota.
rachel_se: CS note: renewal = "at-risk". we'll attach a post-demo survey + offer a 1:1 enablement session. capture demo outcome, latency, and ask for committed usage.
ashley_net: ops question 9 should we rotate header token after demo? customer asked about one-time demo token.
miguel_ops: prefer one-time header token + rotation window. We'll accept header pair for demo only and then revoke. Also rotate any demo tokens generated by proxy.
lina_cs: please include a short success playbook in the follow-up asking for 3 quick wins and pricing note. schedule 1:1 if demo is good.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-6122: "ZenPath JP multi-edge allowlist + transient uplift" (expires 2026-06-10T11:00:00+09:00). Assigned miguel_ops.
miguel_ops: pushed rules to osaka-edge & tokyo-edge (CIDR + header pair). KV cache warmed for prefix zenpath/pilot. Fallback routing & traffic shaping configured. Token rotation scheduled at 11:05 JST. Eval endpoint: /evals/zenpath-pilot with telemetry tags. Ticket CS-6122 updated with pre-demo checklist and logs.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 30 minutes before start to #cs-oncall and assigned owner.
rachel_se: i'll prepare the survey link and 1:1 invite; mark renewal as "engaging" pending demo result.
takashi_zenpath: will run smoke tests at 09:15 JST and 09:45 JST. appreciate the quick help :pray: 
lina_cs: nice. i'll follow up post-demo with playbook + renewal outreach steps. Good luck team :rocket:
